preflight.criterion: Atualizar narração EN/PT e quatro legendas para contagens v402 e duas correções D; duração/timing/loudness conferidos; Edge público autorizado, recibos idempotentes; sem voz pessoal.

changes.before: Identity returns with residual {id_true}. The proof ladder now displays {proof_ladder_clean} theorems.
changes.after: Identity returns with residual {id_true}. The proof ladder now displays {proof_ladder_clean} ladder flags (named declarations), all clean.

changes.before: L’identité revient avec un résidu de {id_true}. L’échelle de preuve affiche {proof_ladder_clean} théorèmes.
changes.after: L’identité revient avec un résidu de {id_true}. L’échelle de preuve affiche {proof_ladder_clean} marqueurs de l’échelle (déclarations nommées), tous propres.

changes.before: A identidade retorna com resíduo {id_true}. A escada de prova exibe {proof_ladder_clean} teoremas.
changes.after: A identidade retorna com resíduo {id_true}. A escada de prova exibe {proof_ladder_clean} bandeiras da escada (declarações nomeadas), todas limpas.

changes.before: 恒等返回的残差为 {id_true}。证明阶梯显示 {proof_ladder_clean} 个定理。
changes.after: 恒等返回的残差为 {id_true}。证明阶梯显示 {proof_ladder_clean} 个阶梯标志（具名声明），全部干净。

changes.before: Together: calibrated z {z_disc}, one-sided p {p_disc}, threshold {threshold_sigma} sigma. The result remains below the threshold.
changes.after: The three supports count together, each with its own status: calibrated z {z_disc}, one-sided p {p_disc}, threshold {threshold_sigma} sigma. The result remains below the threshold.

changes.before: Ensemble : z calibré {z_disc}, p unilatéral {p_disc}, seuil {threshold_sigma} sigma. Le résultat reste sous le seuil.
changes.after: Les trois appuis comptent ensemble, chacun avec son propre statut : z calibré {z_disc}, p unilatéral {p_disc}, seuil {threshold_sigma} sigma. Le résultat reste sous le seuil.

changes.before: Juntos: z calibrado {z_disc}, p unilateral {p_disc}, limiar {threshold_sigma} sigma. O resultado permanece abaixo do limiar.
changes.after: Os três apoios contam juntos, cada um com o seu estatuto: z calibrado {z_disc}, p unilateral {p_disc}, limiar {threshold_sigma} sigma. O resultado permanece abaixo do limiar.

changes.before: 共同显示：校准 z 为 {z_disc}，单侧 p 为 {p_disc}，阈值为 {threshold_sigma} sigma。结果仍低于阈值。
changes.after: 三个支撑共同发挥作用，各自保有其地位：校准 z 为 {z_disc}，单侧 p 为 {p_disc}，阈值为 {threshold_sigma} sigma。结果仍低于阈值。

changes.before: Clausius links heat, surface gravity and area, yielding Einstein’s coefficient. The kernel ladder has {proof_ladder_clean} theorems; the gate has {flags_computed} calculated and {flags_literal} literal flags.
changes.after: Clausius links heat, surface gravity and area, yielding Einstein’s coefficient. The kernel ladder has {proof_ladder_clean} ladder flags (named declarations), all clean; the gate has {flags_computed} calculated and {flags_literal} literal flags.

changes.before: Clausius relie chaleur, gravité de surface et aire, donnant le coefficient d’Einstein. L’échelle du noyau compte {proof_ladder_clean} théorèmes ; la porte, {flags_computed} indicateurs calculés et {flags_literal} littéraux.
changes.after: Clausius relie chaleur, gravité de surface et aire, donnant le coefficient d’Einstein. L’échelle du noyau compte {proof_ladder_clean} marqueurs de l’échelle (déclarations nommées), tous propres ; la porte, {flags_computed} indicateurs calculés et {flags_literal} littéraux.

changes.before: Clausius liga calor, gravidade superficial e área, dando o coeficiente de Einstein. A escada do kernel tem {proof_ladder_clean} teoremas; o gate, {flags_computed} bandeiras calculadas e {flags_literal} literais.
changes.after: Clausius liga calor, gravidade superficial e área, dando o coeficiente de Einstein. A escada do kernel tem {proof_ladder_clean} bandeiras da escada (declarações nomeadas), todas limpas; o gate, {flags_computed} bandeiras calculadas e {flags_literal} literais.

changes.before: 克劳修斯关系连接热量、表面引力与面积，给出爱因斯坦系数。内核阶梯有 {proof_ladder_clean} 个定理；门控有 {flags_computed} 个计算标志和 {flags_literal} 个字面标志。
changes.after: 克劳修斯关系连接热量、表面引力与面积，给出爱因斯坦系数。内核阶梯有 {proof_ladder_clean} 个阶梯标志（具名声明），全部干净；门控有 {flags_computed} 个计算标志和 {flags_literal} 个字面标志。
